text:
Maria: heads-up — seeing repeated 99th pct tail spikes on pool-dedicated-32 in apac-north1 since 03:20 UTC, CPU fine but token-serving latency jumps ~350ms for a subset of tenants. correlates w/ host-level egress bursts from a single tenant IP.
Ashok: can you paste the pmon/pci counters and a short `dmesg` window? suspect PCIe DMA or NIC offload contention.
Maria: pasted the short dump (snipped):
```
[03:19:58] node-32 pcie_read_bytes: 1.9GB/s -> 3.2GB/s
[03:20:05] nvidia: DMA engine busy 87%
[03:20:07] kernel: net_eth0: skb_tx_time > 200ms for qdisc
```
Ashok: yeah that looks like host egress saturation coincident with GPU DMA spikes. likely gpudirect / peer-to-peer burst plus high UDP traffic from that tenant.
Devon: short term we can apply host-level egress shaping (tc token bucket) per tenant slice and enable probe-based backpressure in the scheduler to avoid colocating multiple noisy tenants. low-risk.
Kai: note from last quarter's lab: soft isolation (qdisc + slice-aware scheduling) reduced 99th by ~30% but avg latency went up ~2% and CPU steal increased slightly. tradeoff but usually fine for user-facing SLAs.
Ashok: propose rollout plan: label 5 nodes in pool-dedicated-32 as `isolation=soft-canary`, update router to prefer those for noisy-flagged tenants, and add a monitor that moves a tenant to a dedicated reserved pool if egress > 500MB/s for >5min.
Maria: rough cost/capacity question — how many extra nodes would we need if we offload 3 noisy tenants to dedicated pools?
Kai: quick ballpark: offloading 3 large noisy tenants ~= 2 additional 8xA100s (depends on sequence lengths/throughput). soft-canary itself is cheap (CPU qdisc config) but dedicated pools add ~18% monthly infra cost for that rack.
Devon: I'll own the canary job. steps: (1) patch node-allocator to respect `isolation=soft-canary` label (2) apply `tc qdisc` preset (3) add metric rule in router for auto-move -> dedicated.
Maria: can we make the router move be non-destructive (move to reserved but keep same model variant)? want graceful fallback.
Ashok: yes — router move keeps model variant, just pins to reserved capacity. we add a cooldown and automatic revert when egress < 200MB/s for 10min.
infra-bot: automated: nodes labeled: node-32,node-33,node-34 with `isolation=soft-canary` at 1862501400
sre-bot: alert -> creating canary runbook draft in /runbooks/egress-soft-isolation.md (DRAFT)
Maria: plan sounds good. start canary for 3h window, collect pmon/pci/nic metrics and perf traces. @Devon please post logs and perf summary when done. :thumbsup:
Devon: on it — will kick off job in 5m and attach perf dump here when finished.
Kai: after canary, if 99th still high, we can discuss auto-eviction thresholds and quota-based charging for noisy tenants.
Maria: thanks all — schedule follow-up at 1862505200 (in 1h) to review canary.
Devon: acknowledged.
